name: Accumulator bank
function: Nitrogen-precharged bottles that store hydraulic volume so every actuated valve can be closed at least once if the pump stops.

tabs.overview: Sized for the total closing volume of all actuators plus margin; precharge checked before the job.
tabs.engineering: Pressure vessels with a precharge below the operating pressure; rated per the vendor.
tabs.safety: Accumulators hold stored energy after the pump is off; they are bled before maintenance.
tabs.evidence: API 6A (S1) for pressure-containing parts and connections; public OEM pages (S2, S3, S5, S11, S12) for configurations; field and manufacturing practice (S9).

hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
